title: Trader Joe's Organic Frozen Blueberries, 16oz
content: Grabbed this from the Trader Joe's on Stevens Creek and did not notice until I got home that the bag had a small tear near the top seal, right where it is supposed to be sealed shut. A lot of the berries at the top were already frosted and clumped together like air had got in. The tear looked like it was there before I picked it up off the shelf.
